decisions.decision: Build app/scripts/probe-survey-worker.mjs. Start the local centre on :8790 with wrangler dev and local D1, and apply migrations up to 0011_survey_answers. Sign in a unique test attendee the same way probe-live-qa.mjs does on :8790. Open /materials/survey.html#day-2 and fill every Day 2 question. Save it, and check that POST /api/survey returns 200. Open a fresh browser context with no shared storage, sign the same attendee in again and open #day-2. Check that every answer comes back. Also check that a request with no session gets a 401. Delete the test attendee's rows at the end. In probe-survey.mjs, keep the deep-link checks and drop the old OPS_BASE ops-mode check. Remove the ?sid hint from the survey.html comment. Run both probes until they pass, commit and push to main, add the commands and output to Evidence, and set the task to review for Ben and Bharath.
decisions.why: Pass 2 on 2026-10-08 found the ?sid and ops :8787 follow-ups obsolete since 9c4df62, which moved saving to the Worker's D1 survey_answers. Only probe-survey.mjs exists, and it tests the ops path. probe-live-qa.mjs already shows how to sign in on :8790. Everything is local and buildable, so nothing needs Adi.

Both done-when criteria are met. probe-survey-worker.mjs passed 15/15: it saved Day 2, restored it in a fresh context, got 401 with no session, and covered SURVEY_LEGACY plus the Tantra/Resend options (T-022 ripple). Deep-link probe passes. Pushed 7d8ccb1/8f3957f. Ben and Bharath still need to review.
